tabs.code:
-- "Orders this year": YEAR() runs on every index entry
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Orders
WHERE YEAR(CreatedAt) = 2026;

-- "Placed in the last 30 days": arithmetic on the column
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Orders
WHERE DATEADD(day, 30, CreatedAt) >= @today;
-- Tested: Index Scan, 2,005 reads

WHERE CreatedAt >= '2026-01-01' AND CreatedAt < '2027-01-01';
-- Tested: Index Seek, 170 reads

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Orders
WHERE CreatedAt >= DATEADD(day, -30, @today);
-- Tested: Index Seek, 38 reads
